- Added sentinel `ErrAttachedFunctionOffsetWouldRegress`.

- Added `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry(id, collectionID, newOffset)` and `UpdateHeapEntryPending(id, pending)` to `IAttachedFunctionDb`.
- dao impl: `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry` uses a `completion_offset < newOffset` WHERE guard and returns `ErrAttachedFunctionOffsetWouldRegress` when no rows are affected; `UpdateHeapEntryPending` is idempotent.
- Added both methods to the mockery-style mock.

### Coordinator (`go/pkg/sysdb/coordinator/task_finish.go`)
- `TryFinishAsyncAttachedFunctionInvocation`: runs in a transaction — fetches the attached function by ID, its function record, the collection record (via `GetCollectionWithoutMetadata`), then calls `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry`. Propagates the regress error; returns `NeedsRepair` when `LogPosition > newOffset`, else `Success`. `UpdateCompletionOffsetAndHeapEntry` runs on every invocation, giving idempotent responses under mocks.
- `FinalizeAsyncAttachedFunctionRepair`: calls `UpdateHeapEntryPending(id, false)` and returns a non-nil response; idempotent.
